title: GroScore
description: Computational chemistry toolkit for protein-protein affinity scoring with molecular dynamics. GroScore estimates binding affinities between protein pairs from short steered molecular dynamics simulations in explicit solvent, orchestrating GROMACS through SLURM job arrays or a local GPU pool. GroScore-FE computes absolute binding free energies with Boresch restraints and bidirectional non-equilibrium switching, combined with BAR, CGI and average-work estimators.
